hong_kong_result.content:
Two lines on the left leg: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'HONG KONG'.

Family I is Kader. Family II 1a has the H of HONG KONG under the ©. Family II 1b has the H starting after the ©, under the first G. Toltoys is the same stamp on green plastic. Family III and IV are Unitoy. Lili Ledy and Poch have no stamp of their own.

Full Jawa guide:
https://www.variantvillain.com/characters/sw/jawa/
